title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (toe) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after being limited by a toe injury on Wednesday. He should be available to play in Week 6 and will likely be an involved RB2 for the Steelers behind Jaylen Warren moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Ramsey has been playing through a wrist injury for a while, so it was no surprise to see him sidelined at Pittsburgh's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He made his return to practice on Thursday and should be good to go for Week 6, barring setbacks.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: DeAndre Carter signs with Lions
items.desc: DeAndre Carter has signed to join the Lions' practice squad.
items.impact: Carter has yet to play this season after he was released by the Browns in late August. The veteran appeared in four games for the Browns last season, returning six punts and 11 kickoffs while playing solely on special teams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Sills V (hamstring) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: David Sills V (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Sills recently had his 21-day practice window opened and has been a full participant at practice all week so far. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be a relevant fantasy option moving forward, however, even when he's back to full health.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tristan Wirfs (knee) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Tristan Wirfs (knee) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Wirfs has been a full participant at practice all week so far, so it looks like he's going to be available to play in Week 6. His expected presence is great news for Tampa Bay's offense as they prepare for a tough matchup against the Steelers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sean Tucker (quad) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Sean Tucker (quad) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tucker was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being sidelined by a quad injury on Wednesday. This is a good sign that he will play in Week 6, but we won't know his official status until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring) sits out Thursday's practice
items.desc: Rashee Rice (hamstring) did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Rice has missed practice each of the past two days due to a hamstring issue. Rice sustained the injury in Week 4, and his status for Sunday's game certainly seems in question. Jalen Royals stands to see an uptick in snaps if Rice sits.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Spears was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a knee issue, but he was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday. It's still unclear if this was simply a load management move on the part of the team or if this is a real issue for him, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his status heading into the weekend and expect more work for Tony Pollard if Spears is ruled out for Week 6.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (rest) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was given the day off on Wednesday as a veteran rest day, and he was able to make his return to practice as a full participant on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 6 and will be primed for more work than usual if Tyjae Spears (knee) is limited or sidelined against the Colts on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amani Hooker (concussion) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Amani Hooker (concussion) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hooker was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday, so it looks like he is very close to fully clearing the NFL's concussion protocols. He should be available to play in Week 6, which is good news for Tennessee's secondary ahead of a matchup against the Colts.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Martin-Robinson (hamstring) limited again Thursday
items.desc: David Martin-Robinson (hamstring) was limited for another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Martin-Robinson's hamstring injury left him limited for another practice on Thursday. It seems likely that he will play through it in Week 6, but we won't know for sure until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) was a non-participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Parham wasn't able to practice again on Thursday, which comes as no surprise, as he is still dealing with his knee injury. He seems likely to be sidelined in Week 6, which is less than ideal for New York's offense ahead of a matchup against the Patriots' defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie is at risk of being sidelined on Sunday. He's still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and remained limited for another practice on Thursday as a result. If he's unable to play, look for Mason Taylor to again serve as New York's top tight end in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logs limited practice Thursday
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logged a limited practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was able to participate in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion. He is drawing close to a return from the ankle injury that left him on injured reserve, but it's still unclear whether or not his return will come in time for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Patriots.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joseph Ossai (ankle) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (ankle) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Ossai missed another practice session on Thursday due to the ankle injury that he's recovering from. He may very well be sidelined in Week 6, which would leave New York's defensive front weaker than usual ahead of a big divisional matchup against the Patriots.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) did not take part in New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell was again a non-participant at practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a finger injury. He will almost certainly be sidelined again in Week 6, but the potential return of rookie 	Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) could help to offset the effects of Mitchell's likely absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) was officially a non-participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall was seen working with trainers off to the side at practice on Thursday, but he wasn't able to take part in any official drills and ended up being a non-participant. Fantasy managers should expect him to be sidelined for at least one more game, which will lead to more work for Braelon Allen against the Patriots.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: New England's star cornerback seems likely to play in Week 6. He was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday after being limited by a shoulder issue on Wednesday, and he told reporters earlier in the week that he will be good to play. New England's defense will greatly benefit from the likely return of their star cornerback in a divisional matchup against the Jets this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Carlton Davis III (neck) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran cornerback wasn't able to practice again on Thursday, as he is still dealing with a neck injury that left him sidelined last week. He seems likely to be sidelined again in Week 6, but we won't know for sure for at least another day.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Campbell (knee) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Will Campbell (knee) was listed as limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The young offensive lineman was limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to nurse a knee injury that he recently suffered. Friday's injury report should tell us more about whether or not he will play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) again limited Thursday
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) was again limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran remains limited due to a foot issue. It isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 6, however, so New England's offensive line should be close to full strength if Will Campbell (knee) is also able to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) limited Thursday
items.desc: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited at Thursday's practice. This should come as no surprise, as this shoulder injury has been bugging him for a while. It shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 6, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) officially limited again Thursday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was officially limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Henderson was officially a limited participant at another practice on Thursday. He recently suffered a high-ankle sprain, but it's a very encouraging sign that it has not caused him to miss any practice time. It still seems more likely than not that he will be sidelined in Week 6, but we won't know for sure until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Craig Woodson (shoulder) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Craig Woodson (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young defensive back was left limited at Thursday's practice again as part of the injury management for his shoulder. He should be good to go for Week 6, however, and will continue to be a key defender for New England moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) limited again Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown was able to log another limited practice session on Thursday. He has yet to be officially activated, and the team has not yet made a decision on whether or not he will play in Week 6. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his status over the next 24 hours, as we should get an official injury designation for him after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darius Slayton (knee) full participant Thursday
items.desc: Darius Slayton (knee) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday. He was sidelined in Week 5 due to his knee injury, but it doesn't seem to be much of an issue for him anymore, and he should play through it in Week 6. He will see more work than usual if Ashton Dulin (hamstring) is ruled out against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) was sidelined at Indianapolis' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dulin wasn't able to practice again on Thursday, which comes as no surprise, as he's dealing with a moderately serious hamstring injury right now. He isn't likely to play in Week 4, which will open the door for Darius Slayton (knee) to see more work than usual against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keenan Allen (rest) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Keenan Allen (rest) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Allen was held out of Wednesday's practice, but it was just a rest day for him and he was back at practice in a full capacity on Thursday. He should play in Week 6 but is hard to trust from a fantasy perspective at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trevor Etienne (ankle) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Trevor Etienne (ankle) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: Etienne still hasn't been officially activated for the Panthers, but he seems to be trending the right way for Week 6, as he has been a full participant at both practices to start the week. Carolina may need him more than usual with AJ Dillon (ankle) at risk of being sidelined as well.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tommy Tremble (rib) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Tommy Tremble (rib) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to practice on Thursday, though he remained limited again due to the rib issue that he's managing. He could be sidelined in Week 6, and if he is, fantasy managers should expect Darren Waller (toe) to play more snaps in a matchup against the Eagles.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darren Waller (toe) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Darren Waller (toe) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was a limited participant for another practice on Thursday. His toe injury doesn't seem to be a serious issue, but there's always a chance that it will leave him out for a week. Tommy Tremble (rib) would see more work if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Taylor Moton (lung) full participant Thursday
items.desc: Taylor Moton (lung) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran lineman was again a full participant at practice on Thursday, which means that he is likely to make his return to the lineup for Week 6. His anticipated return would be great news for Carolina's offense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Monroe Freeling (knee) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Monroe Freeling (knee) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Freeling was able to return to practice as a limited participant on Thursday after failing to practice on Wednesday due to a knee issue. He could be available to play in Week 6, but we won't know for sure until closer to game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran edge rusher is still limited at practice due to a nagging hamstring issue, but it seems like he will still have a good chance to play in Week 6. His availability would be good news for the Panthers ahead of a road matchup against Philadelphia.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Damien Lewis (elbow) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Damien Lewis (elbow) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Lewis was again limited on Thursday, as he continues to nurse a lingering elbow injury of some kind. He should be able to play through it in Week 6, however, which is good news for the Panthers ahead of a tough matchup against Philadelphia's strong defensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: AJ Dillon (ankle) officially DNP Thursday
items.desc: AJ Dillon (ankle) officially did not practice for the Panthers on Thursday.
items.impact: Dillon wasn't seen during the open portion of Thursday's practice, and now it has been confirmed that he was again a non-participant. It looks like he may be sidelined in Week 6, which would lead to more work for Trevor Etienne (ankle), if he's active against the Eagles.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Coker (quad) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Coker was able to log another full practice session on Thursday. He's expected to be close to full health for Sunday's game against the Eagles, in which case fantasy managers can feel comfortable starting him in that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Gordon (calf) full participant Thursday
items.desc: Kyler Gordon (calf) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Gordon was able to practice in a full capacity again on Thursday, which puts him in line to play in Week 6. It remains to be seen if the team will officially activate him in time to play on Sunday, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: T.J. Edwards (hamstring) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: T.J. Edwards (hamstring) was sidelined from Chicago's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran missed another practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a hamstring issue of some kind. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined in Week 6, which would be bad news for Chicago's already-vulnerable defense ahead of a matchup against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hip) limited Thursday
items.desc: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hip) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Stevenson was able to practice on Thursday, although he remained limited again due to a hip issue that he's managing. It looks like he's going to play through it in Week 6, but we can't say for sure at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: Williams has now logged two-straight full practices to start the week, which all but confirms that he will be back in the lineup and starting for Chicago this week. His anticipated return will be good news for the fantasy value of Chicago's entire offense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) did not take part in Chicago's practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The young running back has been sidelined for both of Chicago's practices to start the week, which doesn't bode well for his Week 6 availability after he was sidelined by these same issues last week. Roschon Johnson will again step up and see more work as the RB2 for the Bears if Monangai is not able to play on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) has practice window opened
items.desc: Christian Kirk (calf) has been designated to return from injured reserve, opening up his 21-day practice window.
items.impact: Kirk has been sidelined for the entire regular season so far due to a calf injury of some kind. It appears that he's close to full health again, as the team just opened up his 21-day practice window. His return, whenever it comes, will add much-needed depth to a banged-up 49ers offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Penix was able to practice in full for a second-straight day on Thursday, squarely putting him on track to start in Week 6. Assuming he suffers no setbacks, fantasy managers should expect him to play, which is the best outcome for the fantasy value of players like Bijan Robinson and Drake London this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: C.J. Henderson (groin) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: C.J. Henderson (groin) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Henderson suffered a groin injury in Week 5 and has been a non-participant at practice all week as a result. It looks like he's likely to be sidelined on Sunday, which would be bad news for Atlanta's defense ahead of a challenging matchup against the Bears' offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Za'Darius Smith (neck) limited Thursday
items.desc: Za'Darius Smith (neck) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith has officially cleared the NFL's concussion protocols and is no longer listed with that issue. He was still limited at practice on Thursday, however, as he is still managing a lingering neck issue. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 6, which would be great news for the Falcons ahead of a matchup against Chicago this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Matthews (groin) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Jake Matthews (groin) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Matthews was able to log a full practice session on Thursday, which is unsurprising after he practiced in full on Wednesday. His groin injury isn't serious right now and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 6.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andy Dalton has offers from multiple teams
items.desc: Andy Dalton reportedly has offers from multiple teams.
items.impact: Dalton was released by the Eagles, but they reportedly left the door open for his return on their practice squad. That was before the Jalen Hurts latest blood-clot development. It is unclear where he'll end up.
